items.text: Ladd McConkey ruled out with a concussion after evaluation for head injury mid-game.
items.why: Head injury sustained in game; entered protocol.
items.implication: Chargers WR targets redistribute rest of game and potentially next week; protocol timeline uncertain.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining Chargers WRs (e.g. Johnston).

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive for Browns. Only Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime (just signed) available behind him.
items.why: Ankle injury; failed to progress enough in pregame workout after limited Friday.
items.implication: Browns RB depth thin; McLaughlin/Estime get all work vs BAL.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity for McLaughlin and Estime in committee.

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive. Tyjae Spears active for Titans.
items.why: Groin; Friday addition to report that did not clear.
items.implication: Colts TE streamers elevated; Spears gets RB work opposite IND.
items.opportunity: TE targets/carries shift in IND; Spears opportunity vs Colts.

items.text: Sunday FantasyFootball injuries we're watching: Davante Adams (leg), Ladd McConkey (concussion), Dalton Kincaid (ribs, returned to game), Romeo Doubs (shoulder), Rashod Bateman (shoulder), Darnell Mooney (neck).
items.implication: Adams status critical for LAR; Kincaid available after return; McConkey already OUT.
items.opportunity: Monitor Adams snaps/role; Kincaid usage post-return.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore is inactive; Josh Palmer is active.
items.why: Shoulder; no early word then confirmed out.
items.implication: Bills WR depth changes; Palmer elevated in role.
items.opportunity: More targets for other BUF pass-catchers.

items.text: Actives today include: Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara, Kenyon Sadiq, Ja’Kobi Lane. Inactives: Quinshon Judkins, Tyler Warren.
items.why: Cleared after Q tags that ETR viewed as more probable.
items.implication: Full go for key fantasy assets; no docks expected.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) and LT Will Campbell (ankle) both officially active. AJ Brown returning, NE close to full health.
items.why: Sources said likely; confirmed active with Brown activated to 53.
items.implication: NE offense near full strength vs Jets.
items.opportunity: Full routes/carries for Brown and Henderson.

items.text: If I have to start a NYG RB I'm still starting Cam as I still think his explosiveness gives him best chance at a score. Esp against NO. But it's certainly a riskier start now. He's more of a flex than RB2. Updated ranks: Skattebo RB28, Najee RB33.
items.why: Explosiveness vs NO still preferred despite downgrade and preseason hate list history; ranks updated post-news.
items.implication: Startable flex but not locked RB2; prefer over some options.
items.conflict: Conflicts somewhat with pure usage drop if Najee takes early-down/goal-line.

items.text: Cam Skattebo currently 37th out of 43 qualifying RBs in rush yards over expectation. He's also fumbled four times (lost one). Giants expected to increase Najee Harris role with Skattebo downgraded but still mixed in.
items.why: Poor efficiency + fumbles prompting larger Najee share; all 4 RBs active.
items.implication: Riskier flex; lower floor/ceiling in split.
items.opportunity: Najee Harris role expansion; monitor snap/carry split vs NO.

items.text: Summary of weekend reports: GTD Judkins, Warren, Mike Evans, Christian Kirk. EXPECTED: Caleb Williams, Olave, Kamara, AJ Brown, Henderson, DK Metcalf, Freiermuth, Sadiq. NOT EXPECTED: Deebo Samuel, Jacory Croskey-Merritt, Sean Tucker. ACTIVATED: Jaydon Blue.
items.implication: Core tracking for actives; later confirmed several EXPECTED as ACTIVE and GTDs OUT.
items.opportunity: Deebo out benefits others in WAS; Blue activated for PHI depth.

items.text: Eagles officially placed QB Jalen Hurts on injured reserve and signed RB Jaydon Blue to their active roster. Due to blood clot after consultations.
items.implication: Out multiple weeks; Tanner McKee starts; PHI pass-catchers/RBs impacted long-term.
items.opportunity: Blue added to RB depth; McKee era for Wicks/Goedert etc.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid (ribs) returned to game; listed among Sunday injuries watching but cleared to continue.
items.implication: BUF TE available for remaining snaps/targets.

items.text: With Huntley back under center expect another run heavy approach for BAL against CLE; all in on Andy Reid at home off a bye - Walker should be fresh & ready to rock... and there may be no hotter RB in the NFL these days than Jaylen Warren.
items.why: Run-heavy scripts: BAL with Huntley vs CLE; KC home post-bye for Walker; Warren hot.
items.implication: Strong start signals for both RBs in favorable game scripts.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/goal-line for Walker and Warren.

items.text: Week 6 Love: Mike Evans (WR4 vs WSH), Drake London (WR6), Kyren Williams (RB5), Javonte Williams (RB8), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9), Brock Purdy (QB2). Hate: Jaylen Waddle, Emeka Egbuka, Kyle Pitts, J.K. Dobbins, Bo Nix, Justin Herbert.
items.why: Matchups (WSH buffet for pass catchers), volume, scripts, and defenses leaking or shutting down.
items.implication: Prioritize loves in lineups; fade hates due to tough spots/QB issues.
items.opportunity: High-volume spots for loves; avoid low-floor hates.
